P1.7.text: Advancing Engineering and Innovating Technology Solutions

P1.8.text: In 30 seconds, discover how Amentum supports nuclear programs with rigorous safety, specialized engineering, and end-to-end program management. From design engineering, operations to regulatory compliance, security and decommissioning, our globally integrated teams bring local insight and disciplined execution throughout the entire lifecycle. See how we deliver safe and reliable nuclear solutions.

P1.9.text: Golden Dome: Strengthening Our Nation’s Defense

P1.10.text: Golden Dome delivers a resilient, multi-layered shield against hypersonic, ballistic, cruise missiles and advanced threats. This initiative integrates cutting-edge technologies to enhance national security.

P1.11.text: Amentum and the Artemis Program: Powering Humanity’s Return to the Moon and Beyond

P1.12.text: NASA’s Artemis Program represents a bold new chapter in human spaceflight—rekindling the spirit of exploration and setting our sights beyond Earth’s orbit. With its upcoming launch, Artemis continues to advance the vision of returning astronauts to the lunar surface, including the historic goal of landing the first woman and the first person of color on the Moon. More than just a mission, Artemis is laying the groundwork for sustainable lunar exploration and future crewed journeys to Mars, reshaping our understanding of space and what’s possible for generations to come.

P1.13.text: Creating a secure and vibrant future

P1.14.text: Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. More About Us

P1.15.text: We bring advanced engineering and technology solutions to our customer’s most significant challenges around the world.

P1.16.text: We believe in fostering employee engagement, welcoming all perspectives and contributions, and providing equal access to opportunities and resources for everyone.

P1.18.text: We are committed to advancing energy initiatives providing expertise in renewable energy development, energy efficiency, and resilience projects.

P1.20.text: Amentum offers comprehensive aerospace capabilities, including design, construction, integration, program support, launch and mission operations, and asset management.

P1.21.text: Amentum delivers advanced solutions to support national security and intelligence operations.

P1.22.text: Amentum focuses on providing advanced engineering, technology solutions, and mission support to enhance our military readiness and national security.

P1.23.text: Amentum focuses on delivering high-quality technical and operational support to federal agencies and commercial clients.

P1.24.text: Amentum’s international business extends its expertise in engineering, technology, and mission support services to clients across the globe.

P1.25.text: Amentum focuses on delivering innovative solutions and technical expertise to a wide range of industries, including energy, manufacturing, and infrastructure.

P1.26.text: Robotics Design and Development for Harsh Environments

P1.27.text: Amentum’s expertise in robotics was born in the harshest environment possible – the interior of nuclear reactors. The skills we have developed are now being used to gather data to inform how we can extend the life of infrastructure from roads to waterways and energy networks.
